HUMAN_THYMUS:0000034.D: thymoma / thymic epithelial tumor / thymic carcinoma

HUMAN_THYMUS:0000087.L: Type 2 thymoma tumor epithelial cell (CCL25+ cortical-like)

HUMAN_THYMUS:0000088.L: Type 3 thymoma tumor epithelial cell (CHI3L1+ mTEC-like)

HUMAN_THYMUS:0000095.L: skin-like mimetic medullary thymic epithelial cell

HUMAN_THYMUS:0000103.L: regulatory T cell committed at DP stage

cp: conventional NK: EOMES+ , cytotoxic (PRF1/GZMB/GNLY/NKG7), CD16/FCGR3A+ , CD94/KLRD1+ , CD49a(ITGA1)-negative
ILC1: EOMES-negative (TBX21/T-bet only), non/weakly-cytotoxic, tissue-resident CD49a(ITGA1)+ / CD103(ITGAE)+ , CD127(IL7R)+ , KIT-low
single best discriminator = EOMES (NK+ / ILC1-) plus cytotoxicity (PRF1/GZMB); CD49a(ITGA1) marks ILC1 residency, FCGR3A(CD16) marks conventional NK
thymic NK can be CD127+/GATA3+ weakly-cytotoxic (Vosshenrich 2006, PMID 17013389) so CD127/GATA3 alone do NOT call ILC1 — confirm with EOMES + GZMB/PRF1/FCGR3A
human pure ILC1 is rarely detected and the NK<->ILC1 boundary is a TGFb-driven continuum (Simoni 2017 PMID 27986455; Gao 2017 PMID 28759001)
